and.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'menu_discount_mapping' AND column_name IN ('start_time', 'end_time') AND (udt_name = 'timetz' OR data_type = 'time with time zone')

changeSet.comment: Update menu_discount_mapping table to support timezone-aware scheduling for UTC implementation
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE menu_discount_mapping ALTER COLUMN start_time TYPE timetz USING (to_char(start_time::time, 'HH24:MI:SS') || '+00')::timetz;
ALTER TABLE menu_discount_mapping ALTER COLUMN end_time TYPE timetz USING (to_char(end_time::time, 'HH24:MI:SS') || '+00')::timetz;

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Add performance indexes for UTC discount scheduling queries
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_menu_discount_mapping_valid_from ON public.menu_discount_mapping(valid_from);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_menu_discount_mapping_valid_to ON public.menu_discount_mapping(valid_to);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_menu_discount_mapping_active ON public.menu_discount_mapping(valid_from, valid_to);
